newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Euroyen, JGBs shuffle in stale ranges.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Euroyen, JGBs shuffle in stale ranges.

text.p: SIMEX Euroyen and Japanese government bond (JGB) futures were stuck in well-worn ranges on Tuesday as players adjusted their positions ahead of a Japanese finance ministry bond auction.
The Ministry of Finance (MOF) said it would hold an auction of 10-year bonds on Wednesday. Market sources expect the volume of the offer to be about one trillion yen.
"After the long weekend in Japan, everybody was looking for a level ahead of the MOF's bond auction tomorrow," a senior trader at an Asian institution said.
Activity was also dampened by wariness ahead of the U.S. Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's congressional testimony, due to begin later in the day.
The release of Japan's indices of leading and coincident indicators for May was largely ignored by the market as the figures were within expectations, he said.
The benchmark March Euroyen contract was at 99.01 at 1132 GMT after trading a 99.00-99.03 range against its IMM close at 99.00. Volume was a light 3,212 lots.
September JGBs ended at 125.19 against a previous 125.06.
"As long as JGBs don't break above 125.35, we should be stuck here," the trader said.
December Eurodollars finished at 94.05 against an IMM close at 94.045.
